frontier.hypothesis: The E-s44-3 byte-free reader requirement is sharper than the ledger has stated it: the reader must promote the preheader load's value out of local-alloc WITHOUT creating a register equivalence cse can forward to target's tail reloads of 0xC(s2). Any reader whose value is dead by the tail satisfies this, and the search should be over reader PLACEMENT (a use that ends before the first tail reload) rather than over reader shape.
frontier.mechanism: Cell A proved the promotion itself is ordinary C (blk 13 leaves the local table). Its only defect is that the use sits at the first tail reload, so cse's register equivalence survives to it and deletes it. A use that is consumed and dead before the link stores would leave every tail reload intact, because cse's memory table for ctx+0xC is flushed by the stores to *link that precede rec_a/rec_b.
frontier.next_probe: Build a cell whose second use of the loop-2 addend is consumed strictly INSIDE loop 2's exit block (after the do-while, before the guard's join) - e.g. the loop-2 exit condition re-reading the count through the named local instead of through `base` - so the allocno's death precedes the math_Distance3D argument setup, and score it; then re-run local_extract.py to confirm blk 13 still leaves the local set and objdump the seat.

frontier.hypothesis: A LOCAL-pass $a3 seat is reachable if loop 2's preheader block carries FOUR additional co-live quantities that sort ahead of reg 113 in qty_compare, since each already-allocated qty in the same block calls post_mark_life and occupies the next ascending free regno.
frontier.mechanism: local-alloc.c:2249-2255 scans regno ascending and takes the first free one; local-alloc.c:2164-2172 folds regs_live_at (which post_mark_life writes for each qty allocated earlier in the same block) into `used`. Four earlier qtys spanning [2,6) would occupy $v0,$v1,$a0,$a1, leaving $a2 - five would leave $a3. blk 13 currently has exactly one qty, so the count is the whole lever.
frontier.next_probe: Price the cheapest REAL co-live values available in loop 2's preheader (the guard's count load, sh2, and the loop-1 exit tail's live pointers) by moving their definitions into block 13 and re-running local_extract.py --suggest to read blk 13's qty count and each qty's `got`; the seat should walk $v0 -> $v1 -> $a0 ... one register per added co-live qty, which both validates the model and prices the full distance to $a3.

frontier.hypothesis: The local-alloc SUGGESTED-REGISTER pass is now measured NOT to touch this value, so the remaining unmodelled surface in inverse.py's negative result is reload spill-retry and qty_size, not suggestions - and only one of those is still unread.
frontier.mechanism: s47's inverse.py negative named three unmodelled candidates: 'the local-alloc SUGGESTED-REGISTER pass, qty_size for DImode, or reload spill-retry'. E-s48-2 eliminates the first (no suggestion exists for this qty) and the SUGGDBG-QTY line eliminates the second (size=1, mode=4 SImode, chgsize=0). Reload spill-retry is the only one left.
frontier.next_probe: Run tools/ra_solver/reload_extract.py + inverse_reload.py on the BASE chassis for func_80017848 and check whether reload ever revisits the block-13 assignment (alter_reg / spill-retry), which would be the last modelled route to the seat that has not been read.
